interfaces.prefix: Strict growth C0<C1<... gives |a^P|>=g+1; all later marks fix a and marks >=2 fix b by commutation. The least later unique cut supplies actual ambient pairs for every colour 2..g-1.
interfaces.interval: The full ambient interval theorem applies to H=G_{2..g-1}, which fixes a,b, and counts every nontrivial H orbit, even though P itself is not transitive on its support Y.
interfaces.confinement: When rho0 swaps an H pair, no edge there is ambient-eligible. All eligible edges are confined to the union of the other nontrivial H orbits, satisfying the exact all-edge confinement premise.
interfaces.pair: The literal rho0=(ab)(uv), rho1 preserving E={u,v}, and b^rho1 outside that set distinguish E among P1 orbits by size and the rho0 action. Every later centralizer preserves E, in any ambient degree.

new_statements: The prefix orbit budget f+c<=5 and its exact three residual numerical rows.
A single nontrivial orbit for H is impossible.
An H two-point orbit internally swapped by rho0 is impossible.
The odd action of rho0 must occur in a larger preserved orbit or a pair of exchanged odd orbits.
contributions: The acquired interval and confinement machinery retains its disclosed historical root contribution and reviews. The new initial-interval budget and literal invariant-pair closures are this continuation.
